description: Count the batches a nightly manifest transmission run left undelivered, with the previous night's rotated journal sitting in the same directory. DISTILL-CANARY-9318077c

files.README.md:
# manifest-push

Overnight job that ships Quillbrook stock manifests to Ridgeway Freight in
batches. Every line is `<UTC time> <level> <message>`.

Refusals caused by a server-side or rate-limit condition are retried inside the
same run, at most three attempts. A batch still refused on its third attempt
ends the run undelivered, and so does a batch rejected for a payload problem,
which is parked on the first attempt. Each undelivered batch gets exactly one
terminal line:

    batch <id> undelivered reason=<reason>

A batch that gets through on a later attempt is delivered.

The journal rotates to manifest-push.log.1 when the next run starts, so
manifest-push.log holds the most recent run.
